title: A credit dated on the as-of date stays in the same bucket as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a customer with an unused credit memo, credit memo A, dated a day before the release.
  • Make sure that before the release was installed, you noted which A/R Detail bucket credit memo A was in with its own date as the as-of date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with credit memo A's date as the as-of date and its customer ticked.
custom_steps: 1. Expand every bucket and find credit memo A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • It is in the same bucket as before the release (today that is "1-30 days past due"): this release does not change how credits are aged.

Changing how such a credit is aged is a separate ticket (SV-11441) outside this release, so this release must leave it as it is.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order)

  • Out of Scope: “Other improvements found in research, each a separate ticket on SV-11315: a credit dated on the as-of date landing in 1-30 instead of Current (SV-11441, checked against QuickBooks first); configurable aging periods (SV-11442); send a statement from the report (SV-11443); salesperson and Parts vs Service filters (SV-11444); last payment date and credit limit (SV-11446); a collections notes log (SV-11447).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
